name: imdr-db
description: Read-only access to the IMDR (Internal Market Data Repository) SQL Server database. Browse schemas, inspect tables, and run SELECT queries — all audit-logged.

IMDR_MSSQL_DRIVER.title: ODBC Driver Name
IMDR_MSSQL_DRIVER.description: ODBC driver name. Run 'python -c "import pyodbc; print(pyodbc.drivers())"' to check. Common values: 'SQL+Server' or 'ODBC+Driver+17+for+SQL+Server'.
